title: Four Thousand Weeks: Time Management for Mortals
description: AN INSTANT NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER "Provocative and appealing . . . well worth your extremely limited time." —Barbara Spindel, The Wall Street Journal The average human lifespan is absurdly, insultingly brief. Assuming you live to be eighty, you have just over four thousand weeks. Nobody needs telling there isn’t enough time. We’re obsessed with our lengthening to-do lists, our overfilled inboxes, work-life balance, and the ceaseless battle against distraction; and we’re deluged with advice on becoming more productive and efficient, and “life hacks” to optimize our days. But such techniques often end up making things worse. The sense of anxious hurry grows more intense, and still the most meaningful parts of life seem to lie just beyond the horizon. Still, we rarely make the connection between our daily struggles with time and the ultimate time management problem: the challenge of how best to use our four thousand weeks. Drawing on the insights of both ancient and contemporary philosophers, psychologists, and spiritual teachers, Oliver Burkeman delivers an entertaining, humorous, practical, and ultimately profound guide to time and time management. Rejecting the futile modern fixation on “getting everything done,” Four Thousand Weeks introduces readers to tools for constructing a meaningful life by embracing finitude, showing how many of the unhelpful ways we’ve come to think about time aren’t inescapable, unchanging truths, but choices we’ve made as individuals and as a society—and that we could do things differently.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstanceaJcPqRWoX8dMu3TQ_-uGrQ')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_a

title: A Beginner's Guide To The Pomodoro Technique: How to Improve your time management skills,
description: The Pomodoro technique is one of the most well-known time-management methodologies. As per this technique, you work for 25 minutes followed by a short 3-5 minute break. You repeat the same cycle 4 times and take a longer break. The simplicity of the technique is the primary reason why it works effectively for most people. This short 20-paged book contains a detailed guide on how to implement the method in real life. title: Time Management Using AI: How to Reclaim Your Time with Proven Principles, Better Systems,
description: What would you do with an extra 5–10 hours every week? Spend more time with your family? Finally make progress on the project you keep postponing? Exercise, build your business, pursue a personal goal—or simply stop ending every day wondering where all your time went? You don't need more hours in the day. You need a better system for the hours you already have. Time Management Using AI combines proven time-management principles with practical AI strategies to help you reduce the invisible work consuming your day: sorting email, managing meetings, reorganizing priorities, coordinating schedules, tracking commitments, handling repetitive tasks, and constantly rebuilding plans when life changes. The goal isn't to let AI run your life. It's to let AI handle more of the busywork so you have more time to live it. Inside, you'll learn how to: Build realistic daily schedules that can survive interruptions and changing priorities Use AI as a personal assistant while keeping important decisions and judgment in your hands Protect deep-work time from unnecessary meetings, messages, and distractions Triage email and extract action items without spending your best hours on administrative work Manage work, family, personal goals, and other responsibilities as one connected system Choose a simple AI tool stack without getting buried in apps and subscriptions Automate repetitive work that quietly steals hours from your week Measure your Time ROI so you know whether AI is actually saving you time Work toward reclaiming 5–10 hours per week by combining smaller savings across your workflows Build a sustainable system that still works when life gets busy And you won't be left wondering how to put it all together. description: Discover How To Manage Your Time, Get More Done, and Enjoy Life In The Process! Do you have too much to do and not enough time to do it? Imagine being a model of work-life success that others admire and want to emulate. You'll learn how to reclaim control of your schedule, optimize your workflow, and safeguard your time so you can spend it on the people and hobbies that matter to you.
